profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Databricks
profile.summary: Jordan is currently a Senior Software Engineer at Databricks working on the Serverless Dataplane team. He was previously a Senior Software Engineer at Google working in the Ads PA. He graduated at the top of his class with a bachelor's degree in computer engineering from the University of Toronto. Jordan has a wide range of industry experience in software engineering, interning at companies like Google, Citadel, Splunk, and Yelp. He is adept at frontend, backend, and mobile development and proficient with numerous programming languages such as C/C++, Java, Python, and Javascript.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working in Bid Manager - DV3 YouTube team

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Working in Platform Engineering team.
• Implemented “stitching” framework to process historical data from ClickHouse and consolidate it with real-time data streaming in from Kafka. Framework creates worker threads and batches ClickHouse queries for reduced latency; publishes data to frontend via WAMP topic
• Designed permissions system (ACLs) for user data access in nextgen monitoring platform

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Working in the Hotels Search Quality team.
• Implemented dynamic amenity filters in frontend hotels immersive based on an amenity's availability in user search area; in backend, queried Knowledge Graph for hotel amenity info to determine which amenities to display in UI.
• Made changes in various backend and frontend stacks (C++, Java, Protobuf, Javascript, Soy) to propagate amenity information in requests and responses.
• Collaborated with UX designers to redesign then implement mobile amenity chip interface in hotels immersive.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Working in the Machine Learning API team.
• Designed and built ML model validation API endpoint (train test split, cross validation).
• Implemented Golang request handler to validate POST and extended Python executor to calculate and save various model scores/summaries (sklearn.metrics) during training.
• Redesigned communication interface between API server and executors using protobufs.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Working in the Distsys Compute, now Compute Infra, team.
• Developed Python service (named Katamari) to control code deployments to stage/prod; it ingests realtime metrics and uses Bayesian inference to assess potential impact of a deployment.
• Implemented various parts of Katamari including initializing internal variables on demand from metric data, serializing beliefs (about deployments) to S3, and Slack and database integration.
• Wrote CLI to communicate with service via API endpoints and roll forward/back code deployments using PaaSTA (https://github.com/Yelp/paasta) commands; integrated this CLI into existing Jenkins pipelines.
• Improved Katamari testing workflow by writing a integration test framework to simulate communication between metric sources, the CLI, and Katamari itself where expected behaviour (roll deployments forward/back) could be confirmed.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Working in the Ads Shopping team.
• Integrated full stack parameter optimization application into existing data analysis framework.
• Implemented RPC calls in backend Python server to optimize parameters and return results via proto buffers to front end.
• Designed intuitive front end interface using AngularJS components (Javascript/ES6) and Angular Material library (HTML/CSS).
• Persisted user optimizer configuration by serializing state to URL.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Working in the Meta team within CZI.
• Designed and implemented service in Java to ingest fulltext research papers (XML, HTML) into Meta's in-house knowledge graph.
• ETL using XML, HTML, and JSON processing tools like XJC, JAXB, XSLT (XPath), JSoup, Jackson.
• Parsed paper content using Stanford NLP library to extract citation proximity information.
• Testing and verification of downloading and parsing results using JUnit, Mockito, Springboot.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Worked with one of Professor Eyal de Lara's graduate students from the Computer Science Department on his PhD project.
• Utilized the Django framework, HTML/CSS, and Javascript to build a web server to accompany a mobile app that assists people afflicted with COPD.

positions.title: Engineering Research Intern
positions.description:
With Professor Jonathan Rose from the Electrical and Computer Engineering Department, I worked on 'myAnkle', an Android physiotherapy app designed to help people recover from ankle injuries.
• Integrated TI SensorTag2 for use as an external accelerometer into the app
• Designed an intuitive game interface for the app to increase user compliance
• Various optimizations and improvements to database, soundpool, and images

• Completed graduate level programming assignments (ECE1778) to learn best practices for Android
• Developed an application that will interact with the TI SensorTag2 to record data from its surroundings (https://github.com/jordanleex13/SensorTag)

honors.title: Adel S. Sedra Gold Medal
honors.description: This award is given to the student in each of the Electrical and Computer Engineering programs who graduates with the highest cumulative academic standing.
honors.issuer: Issued by University of Toronto Faculty of Applied Science & Engineering · Jun 2020

honors.title: 4th Place - Microsoft College Code Competition
honors.description: Placed 4th out of 132 teams in the 2 hour coding competition

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Sold and collected admission tickets and passes from patrons at entertainment events
• Provided assistance with patrons' special needs, such as helping those with wheelchairs
• Organized and led various community events, including holiday functions and multicultural fairs

projects.title: Dönum
projects.description:
• Native Android and iOS applications that aid refugees in finding employment opportunities
• Built with Android Studio (Java) and Xcode (Swift)
• Utilized JSON parsing and Indeed API to display list of jobs in list format
• Used Google Maps API and MapKit to display nearby jobs

projects.title: Spots
projects.description:
• An intuitive and colourful data visualization for iOS.
• Took data from Canada Open Data using namara.io and JSON parsing
• Used Python scripts to store data in SQLite database
• Utilized MapKit and FMDB in front-end to parse SQLite database for coordinates to display data on map
